title: Text fitting and compact formatting controls
summary: Control text overflow and wrapping, with a compact row for alignment, distribution, justification and everyday text formatting.

Added: Advanced text fitting: Do not autofit, Shrink text on overflow and Resize shape to fit text. New text defaults to shrinking on overflow; older projects keep their previous layout.
Wrap text in shape checkbox. Wrapped shape fitting keeps width and fits height; unwrapped fitting adjusts width and height to the text lines.
One compact icon row under Alignment & Distribution and Quick Text Settings, with full-name hover labels and remembered enclosed dropdown choices.
Working Bold, Italic, Increase font size and Decrease font size buttons with selection-wide edits and active state. Real licensed font variants are shared by inline editing and export.
Fitting, wrapping, bold and italic persist in saved templates and editable projects. Live shape resizing and inline text use the shared document layout.
Verified: Native fitting modes, wrapping, bold/italic, geometry Undo/Redo and exact clipboard output; automated template, batch, invalid-input, persistence and multi-zoom caret checks.
The user confirmed all four alpha47 modifier workflows pass physical testing: Alt duplication, Alt centered resize, Shift proportions and Shift+Alt combined, each with one-step Undo.

limitations: Do not autofit clips overflowing text to the content box. Resize shape rejects a result larger than the canvas; choose Shrink or enlarge the canvas instead.
Text formatting applies to the whole object. Mixed formatting within a text box, underline and text effects remain planned.
Full core-tool options, Simplify, crisp vector zoom, editable Library autosave and toolbar ordering remain unfinished.
